script: const out = { paused: game.paused, world: game.world.id, modules: {}, expiryAction: CONFIG.ActiveEffect.expiryAction, playerTray: game.settings.get("dnd5e","allowPlayerDamageTray") }; for (const ns of ["aoe","riders","dropbin","combat","movement","reactions","importer"]) { const api = game.pentaryn?.[ns]; const mod = game.modules.get(`pentaryn-${ns}`); const r = { active: mod?.active, installed: mod?.version }; try { r.describe = api?.describe?.()?.version; } catch (e) { r.describeErr = String(e); } try { const st = await api?.selftest?.(); r.selftest = st ? { ok: st.ok, failed: (st.checks ?? st.results ?? []).filter(c => c.ok === false).map(c => c.name ?? c.label ?? JSON.stringify(c).slice(0,80)) } : "none"; } catch (e) { r.selftestErr = String(e).slice(0,160); } out.modules[ns] = r; } return out;

purpose: Smoke inventory: scenes with Marrith's token and a hostile attacker, existing combats, Bazgar's Precision Attack effect after the importer sweep, the Dread Blade item, an Undead Spirit actor, who has Psionic Lash
script: const marrith = game.actors.getName("Marrith Ashcroft"); const scenes = game.scenes.filter(s => s.tokens.some(t => t.actorId === marrith.id)).map(s => ({ scene: s.name, id: s.id, active: s.active, viewed: s.id === canvas.scene?.id, pcs: s.tokens.filter(t=>t.actor?.hasPlayerOwner).map(t=>t.name), hostiles: s.tokens.filter(t=>t.disposition === -1 && t.actor?.type === "npc").slice(0,6).map(t=>({name:t.name, id:t.id, attacks: t.actor.items.filter(i=>i.system.activities?.some(a=>a.type==="attack")).slice(0,3).map(i=>i.name)})) })); const bazgar = game.actors.getName("Bazgar of the Dakmar'nak"); const pa = bazgar?.items.find(i=>/Precision Attack/.test(i.name)); const ua = game.actors.find(a=>/Unbound Ancient/.test(a.name)); const blade = ua?.items.find(i=>i.name==="Dread Blade"); const spirit = game.actors.filter(a=>/Undead Spirit|Spirit/.test(a.name)).map(a=>({name:a.name, feats:a.items.filter(i=>i.type==="feat").map(i=>i.name).filter(n=>/Incorporeal|Ethereal/i.test(n))})); const lash = game.actors.filter(a=>a.items.some(i=>i.name==="Psionic Lash")).map(a=>({actor:a.name, id:a.id})); return { combats: game.combats.map(c=>({id:c.id, scene:c.scene?.name, round:c.round, started:c.started})), scenes, bazgarPrecision: pa ? pa.effects.map(e=>({name:e.name, expiry:e.duration.expiry, value:e.duration.value})) : null, bazgarDdb: !!bazgar?.flags.ddbimporter, dreadBlade: blade ? { uuid: blade.uuid, noLoot: blade.getFlag("pentaryn-dropbin","noLoot") } : null, spirit, lash, shieldActivity: marrith.items.getName("Shield")?.system.activities.contents[0]?.uuid };

purpose: Smoke K: the Token HUD attribute parser with arithmetic and the unchanged forms
script: const hud = canvas.hud?.token ?? new foundry.applications.hud.TokenHUD(); const P = foundry.applications.hud.TokenHUD.prototype._parseAttributeInput; const r = {}; for (const inp of ["50-10", "=40", "-10", "+5", "50%", "40", "(50-10)/2", "50-"]) { try { r[inp] = P.call(hud, "bar1", { value: 50, max: 60, type: "bar" }, inp); } catch (e) { r[inp] = "ERR " + String(e).slice(0,80); } } return { wrapped: String(P).includes("_pcHpMath") || !!P._pcHpMath, results: r };

purpose: Smoke K with a stubbed HUD token, mark the Dread Blade as never-loot (fixes iXWG4o), read movement status and the reactions API
script: const P = foundry.applications.hud.TokenHUD.prototype._parseAttributeInput; const stub = { object: { document: { getBarAttribute: () => ({ value: 50, max: 60, type: "bar", attribute: "attributes.hp" }) } } }; const k = {}; for (const inp of ["50-10", "=40", "-10", "+5", "50%", "40", "(50-10)/2", "50-"]) { try { k[inp] = P.call(stub, "bar1", { value: 50, max: 60, type: "bar" }, inp); } catch (e) { k[inp] = "ERR " + String(e).slice(0,100); } } const blade = await fromUuid("Actor.T5rR0AxO3kf2Y8er.Item.mOFhWkASKsQxw6ni"); const nl = await game.pentaryn.dropbin.noLoot(blade, { on: true }); const st = game.pentaryn.movement.status?.(); return { hpMath: k, dreadBlade: { result: nl, flag: blade.getFlag("pentaryn-dropbin", "noLoot") }, movementStatusKeys: st ? Object.keys(st) : null, reactionsDescribe: Object.keys(game.pentaryn.reactions.describe?.() ?? {}) };

purpose: Smoke C3/C4 in a throwaway combat: a Shield-shaped turnStart effect created on the dragon's turn should be rewritten to sourceStart and deleted when Marrith's turn starts; combat and effect cleaned up
script: const log = []; const scene = game.scenes.get("ORVyD54IZ6GOtgjm"); const marrith = game.actors.getName("Marrith Ashcroft"); const mTok = scene.tokens.find(t => t.actorId === marrith.id); const dTok = scene.tokens.get("HHKr090x3LYvuiAS"); let combat, eff; try { combat = await Combat.create({ scene: scene.id, active: true }); await combat.createEmbeddedDocuments("Combatant", [{ tokenId: dTok.id, actorId: dTok.actorId, sceneId: scene.id, initiative: 20 }, { tokenId: mTok.id, actorId: marrith.id, sceneId: scene.id, initiative: 5 }]); await combat.startCombat(); log.push({ step: "started", round: combat.round, turn: combat.combatant?.name, gameCombat: game.combat?.id === combat.id }); const src = marrith.items.getName("Shield").effects.contents[0].toObject(); delete src._id; src.name = "ZZ Smoke Barrier"; src.origin = "Actor.RNDTDBlFXxZ7Uc8i.Item.QxTxvsx9TCkohf1n.Activity.dnd5eactivity000"; src.duration = { ...src.duration, value: 6, units: "seconds", expiry: "turnStart" }; [eff] = await marrith.createEmbeddedDocuments("ActiveEffect", [src]); log.push({ step: "created on dragon's turn", expiry: eff.duration.expiry, value: eff.duration.value, startCombatant: eff.duration.startCombatant ?? eff.duration.start?.combatant }); await combat.nextTurn(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2500)); const still = marrith.effects.get(eff.id); log.push({ step: "after nextTurn (Marrith's turn)", turn: combat.combatant?.name, effectStillThere: !!still, expired: still?.isExpired ?? still?.expired, disabled: still?.disabled }); } catch (e) { log.push({ error: String(e).slice(0, 300) }); } finally { try { if (eff && marrith.effects.get(eff.id)) { await eff.delete(); log.push({ cleanup: "effect deleted by hand" }); } } catch (e) { log.push({ cleanupErr: String(e).slice(0,120) }); } try { if (combat) await combat.delete(); log.push({ cleanup: "combat deleted" }); } catch (e) { log.push({ cleanupErr2: String(e).slice(0,120) }); } } return log;

purpose: Smoke C4 + sourceStart on the headless active GM: a sourceStart effect with an explicit combat start should be deleted (not just marked) when Marrith's turn begins; throwaway combat cleaned up
script: const log = []; const scene = game.scenes.get("ORVyD54IZ6GOtgjm"); const marrith = game.actors.getName("Marrith Ashcroft"); const mTok = scene.tokens.find(t => t.actorId === marrith.id); const dTok = scene.tokens.get("HHKr090x3LYvuiAS"); let combat, eff; try { combat = await Combat.create({ scene: scene.id, active: true }); const [dc] = await combat.createEmbeddedDocuments("Combatant", [{ tokenId: dTok.id, actorId: dTok.actorId, sceneId: scene.id, initiative: 20 }, { tokenId: mTok.id, actorId: marrith.id, sceneId: scene.id, initiative: 5 }]); await combat.startCombat(); const src = marrith.items.getName("Shield").effects.contents[0].toObject(); delete src._id; src.name = "ZZ Smoke Barrier 2"; src.origin = "Actor.RNDTDBlFXxZ7Uc8i.Item.QxTxvsx9TCkohf1n.Activity.dnd5eactivity000"; src.duration = { value: null, units: "seconds", expiry: "sourceStart", start: { round: 1, turn: 0, combatant: combat.combatants.find(c=>c.tokenId===dTok.id).id, worldTime: game.time.worldTime } }; [eff] = await marrith.createEmbeddedDocuments("ActiveEffect", [src]); log.push({ step: "created", expiry: eff.duration.expiry, start: eff.duration.start ?? eff._source.duration.start, activeGM: game.users.activeGM?.name }); await combat.nextTurn(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 3000)); const still = marrith.effects.get(eff.id); log.push({ step: "after nextTurn to Marrith", turn: combat.combatant?.name, effectStillThere: !!still, disabled: still?.disabled, expired: still?.expired ?? still?.isExpired }); } catch (e) { log.push({ error: String(e).slice(0, 300) }); } finally { try { if (eff && marrith.effects.get(eff.id)) { await eff.delete(); log.push({ cleanup: "effect deleted by hand" }); } } catch (e) { log.push({ cleanupErr: String(e).slice(0,120) }); } try { if (combat) await combat.delete(); log.push({ cleanup: "combat deleted" }); } catch (e) { log.push({ cleanupErr2: String(e).slice(0,120) }); } } return log;

purpose: Smoke: Marrith's Shield effect flags (to see if a choice rider could disable copies), the HP-math parser with a proper HUD stub, and recent console errors captured since the restart
script: const marrith = game.actors.getName("Marrith Ashcroft"); const sh = marrith.items.getName("Shield").effects.contents[0]; const P = foundry.applications.hud.TokenHUD.prototype._parseAttributeInput; const bar = { value: 50, max: 60, type: "bar", attribute: "attributes.hp" }; const stub = { document: { getBarAttribute: () => bar }, object: { document: { getBarAttribute: () => bar } } }; const k = {}; for (const inp of ["50-10", "=40", "-10", "+5", "50%", "40", "(50-10)/2", "50-"]) { try { const r = P.call(stub, "bar1", bar, inp); k[inp] = { value: r.value, delta: r.delta, isDelta: r.isDelta }; } catch (e) { k[inp] = "ERR " + String(e).slice(0,120); } } let errors = null; try { const insp = await game.pentaryn.feedback.inspect(game.user); errors = (insp?.errors ?? insp?.recent?.errors ?? []).slice(-8).map(e => (e.message ?? e.text ?? JSON.stringify(e)).slice(0,160)); } catch (e) { errors = "inspect failed: " + String(e).slice(0,100); } return { shieldEffectFlags: sh.flags, shieldEffectDisabled: sh.disabled, hpMath: k, recentErrors: errors };

purpose: Smoke: capture which code disables or deletes the throwaway Shield-shaped effect at the turn change (preUpdate/preDelete hooks with stacks); combat and effect cleaned up
script: const log = []; const scene = game.scenes.get("ORVyD54IZ6GOtgjm"); const marrith = game.actors.getName("Marrith Ashcroft"); const mTok = scene.tokens.find(t => t.actorId === marrith.id); const dTok = scene.tokens.get("HHKr090x3LYvuiAS"); const hU = Hooks.on("preUpdateActiveEffect", (e, changes, options, userId) => { if (e.name?.startsWith("ZZ Smoke")) log.push({ hook: "preUpdate", changes, optKeys: Object.keys(options), userId, stack: new Error().stack.split("\n").slice(1, 9).map(s => s.trim().slice(0, 140)) }); }); const hD = Hooks.on("preDeleteActiveEffect", (e, options, userId) => { if (e.name?.startsWith("ZZ Smoke")) log.push({ hook: "preDelete", optKeys: Object.keys(options), userId, stack: new Error().stack.split("\n").slice(1, 7).map(s => s.trim().slice(0, 140)) }); }); let combat, eff; try { combat = await Combat.create({ scene: scene.id, active: true }); await combat.createEmbeddedDocuments("Combatant", [{ tokenId: dTok.id, actorId: dTok.actorId, sceneId: scene.id, initiative: 20 }, { tokenId: mTok.id, actorId: marrith.id, sceneId: scene.id, initiative: 5 }]); await combat.startCombat(); const src = marrith.items.getName("Shield").effects.contents[0].toObject(); delete src._id; src.name = "ZZ Smoke Barrier 3"; src.origin = "Actor.RNDTDBlFXxZ7Uc8i.Item.QxTxvsx9TCkohf1n.Activity.dnd5eactivity000"; src.duration = { value: null, units: "seconds", expiry: "sourceStart" }; [eff] = await marrith.createEmbeddedDocuments("ActiveEffect", [src]); log.push({ step: "created", disabled: eff.disabled, startCombat: eff.start?.combat?.id ?? null }); await combat.nextTurn(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 3000)); const still = marrith.effects.get(eff.id); log.push({ step: "after nextTurn", stillThere: !!still, disabled: still?.disabled }); } catch (e) { log.push({ error: String(e).slice(0, 300) }); } finally { Hooks.off("preUpdateActiveEffect", hU); Hooks.off("preDeleteActiveEffect", hD); try { if (eff && marrith.effects.get(eff.id)) await eff.delete(); } catch {} try { if (combat) await combat.delete(); } catch {} } return log;

purpose: Isolate what disables a newly created effect on Marrith outside combat: a plain effect, a Shield copy with no duration, a Shield copy with sourceStart (all deleted after)
script: const marrith = game.actors.getName("Marrith Ashcroft"); const base = marrith.items.getName("Shield").effects.contents[0].toObject(); const out = { sourceDisabled: base.disabled, inCombat: marrith.inCombat }; const made = []; try { for (const [label, data] of [["plain", { name: "ZZ Smoke plain", changes: [] }], ["copyNoDuration", { ...base, _id: undefined, name: "ZZ Smoke copy", duration: {} }], ["copySourceStart", { ...base, _id: undefined, name: "ZZ Smoke ss", origin: "Actor.RNDTDBlFXxZ7Uc8i.Item.QxTxvsx9TCkohf1n.Activity.dnd5eactivity000", duration: { value: null, units: "seconds", expiry: "sourceStart" } }]]) { delete data._id; const [e] = await marrith.createEmbeddedDocuments("ActiveEffect", [data]); made.push(e); out[label] = { disabled: e.disabled, disabledSource: e._source.disabled, expired: e.duration.expired ?? null, suppressed: e.isSuppressed }; } } catch (err) { out.error = String(err).slice(0, 200); } finally { for (const e of made) { try { await e.delete(); } catch {} } } return out;
